fullPassage: Frederick Law Olmsted, known as the father of American landscape architecture, was born in 1822. When Olmsted was young, he often went on trips to the countryside with his father, who loved scenery. At age 14, he was preparing himself to study at Yale College, but he could not enter due to a severe sumac poisoning that damaged his eyesight. Instead of attending a college, he gained experience working as a clerk, a sailor, and a farmer. In 1858, he worked with Calvert Vaux and won the design competition for New York City's Central Park with the "Greensward Plan." During the Civil War, Olmsted served as General Secretary of the United States Sanitary Commission. Although he passed away in 1903, his sons and successors continued his design philosophy. In 1979, the National Park Service designated his home and office in Brookline, Massachusetts, as a National Historic Site to honor his legacy.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: Olmsted는 어렸을 때(young) 아버지와 시골 여행을 다녔고, 사고로 시력이 손상되었으며(damaged), 그의 후손들이 그의 철학을 계속 이어갔다(continued).
det.analysis:
❌ ① old — damaged — continued: old(나이 든)는 어릴 때 이야기를 하는 문맥과 반대돼요

✅ ② young — damaged — continued: 본문 내용과 정확히 일치해요 ←정답

❌ ③ young — improved — continued: improved(개선된)는 반대예요. 시력이 나빠진 게 아니라 개선됐다는 건 앞뒤가 안 맞아요

❌ ④ young — damaged — abandoned: abandoned(버려진)는 반대예요. 후손들이 철학을 이어갔다는 게 맞아요
det.tip: young(어린) ↔ old(나이 든), damage(손상시키다) ↔ improve(개선하다), continue(계속하다) ↔ abandon(버리다)

det.korean: Olmsted는 심각한(severe) 옻나무 중독을 겪었고, 대학 대신 여러 일을 하며 경험을 얻었으며(gained), 남북전쟁 중에는 위생 위원회 총무로 근무했다(served).

❌ ④ demolished(철거된): 원문은 designated(지정된)예요. 유산을 기리기 위해 지정한 것이지 철거한 게 아니에요 ←정답

det.analysis: ✅ attending: attend(원형) → attending(동명사). 전치사 instead of 뒤에는 동사원형이 아니라 동명사(-ing)가 와야 해요.
det.tip: 전치사(instead of, after, without 등) 뒤에는 반드시 동명사(-ing)를 씁니다. attend → attending
